stem.en: Each event changes one thing. Sort the events by what they change.

label.en: The text it can read now

text.en: A new training run on a corrected pile
You tell the chatbot that a date was wrong
An app pastes in a page from a search
A long chat pushes old lines past the edge
The app turns temperature down to 0.2
A user moves temperature up to 1.6

explanation.en: Only training changes settings. Whatever you type, and whatever an app pastes in, is more text in the context window, and a long chat can push old text out of it. Temperature changes the chances of being picked and leaves the scores as they are.

hints.en: Ask whether training is happening at all.
